summary: The registrant, KKR FS Income Trust, filed an 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 solely to declare a routine monthly dividend of $0.225 per share, payable on June 26, 2026, to shareholders of record as of May 29, 2026. Shareholders may elect to receive cash or additional shares via the distribution reinvestment plan. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or abrupt management change is present. This filing is a standard current report of ordinary dividend declaration with no event-driven or transformative corporate action.
